sources.title: Google AdSense required privacy content
sources.access: official body read in EN and JA
supports: Disclose Google/third-party advertising cookies and use of prior visits to this and other websites.
Provide personalized-ad controls; name and link actual participating providers when third-party serving is used.
sources.application: Public policy contains conditional future-ad disclosure and Google/DAA controls. Actual provider list is not invented before selection.
sources.limits: Google does not supply one universally compliant policy text. This source does not certify the site's legal compliance or approval.

sources.title: How Google uses information from sites or apps that use its services
sources.access: official relevant body read in EN and JA
supports: Using Google advertising can send page URL/IP and involve reading or setting cookies.
Stated purposes include service delivery, ad measurement, fraud prevention and personalization according to settings.
Site/app consent changes should be made at the site/app.
sources.application: Explain conditional data transfer and purposes; distinguish Google's settings from future on-site consent.
sources.limits: Does not mean the current site sends advertising data to Google. No advertising services are currently enabled.

sources.title: Google EU user consent policy
supports: For applicable Google products and EEA/UK/Swiss users, consent is required for cookies/local storage where legally required and for personalized-ad personal data.
Identify recipients, retain consent records and provide withdrawal instructions.
sources.application: State no ad activation before required arrangements; plan refusal, purpose choices and reopening/withdrawal.
sources.limits: No blanket claim that every region and ad mode has identical consent requirements; no consent record is currently collected.

sources.title: Google consent management requirements for publishers
sources.access: official applicable requirements and certification-scope body read in EN and JA
supports: Personalized Google ads to EEA/UK/Swiss users require a Google-certified CMP integrated with IAB TCF.
Google certification does not establish complete compliance with applicable privacy laws.
sources.application: Conditional public commitment to an actual certified service. A homemade banner/settings link is not described as certified.
sources.limits: No provider selected, connected or tested. The live certification list and applicable TCF version must be rechecked before activation.

sources.title: Google AdSense personalized and non-personalized ads
supports: Non-personalized ads may still use cookies for frequency capping and aggregate reporting, with consent where legally required.
sources.application: Avoid saying non-personalized advertising is cookie-free or automatically removes consent duties.
sources.limits: Limited/programmatic-limited ad behavior is a separate implementation decision, not covered by a blanket no-consent statement.

sources.title: Google My Ad Center Help: personalized ads and partner ad settings
supports: Official Partner Ad Settings link is https://adssettings.google.com/partnerads.
Settings' availability and scope vary by account, browser and device; not all networks are covered.
Turning personalization off does not remove all ads.
sources.application: Use partner-specific settings instead of implying My Ad Center's preferred-topic controls universally govern partner websites.
sources.limits: Direct Partner Ad Settings fetch redirected through Google's account/browser check and could not be completed by web tool. Link provenance is the official help anchor; no account setting was changed.

sources.title: Digital Advertising Alliance WebChoices
sources.access: official Google referral followed; DAA public body read
supports: Opt-out choices apply to participating advertising companies and the browser; not a universal provider/device preference.
sources.application: Provide the alternative third-party ad control with its scope stated.
sources.limits: No opt-out submitted, extension installed or browser setting changed.

sources.title: GitHub Pages: data collection
supports: GitHub logs/stores visitors' IP addresses for security irrespective of sign-in.
sources.application: Do not equate no own analytics/cookies with no hosting-level information processing.
sources.limits: No hosting retention period invented. Hosting suitability for commercial use remains a separate root task.

sources.title: GitHub General Privacy Statement
supports: Canonical GitHub statement provides its own processing, retention and rights information.
sources.application: Link visitors to the hosting provider's statement alongside the specific Pages IP disclosure.
sources.limits: No claim of a full clause-by-clause hosting legal audit during this task.

sources.title: Google Privacy Policy
sources.access: official introductory scope/effective-date/topic index read in EN and JA; linked by Google partner-data explanation
supports: Google links its policy for processing, controls, retention and applicable grounds.
sources.application: Provide Google privacy information for future advertising and the present external Google Maps link.
sources.limits: Do not copy a universal retention period or claim these links replace site-specific information required by applicable laws.

remainingBeforeActivation: Confirm hosting commercial-use suitability and an actual AdSense-accepted property/ownership connection.
Select actual provider/ad mode/geographic operation and identify all relevant recipients.
Connect and validate a real certified CMP when required; consent records and withdrawal behavior must be operational.
Assess controller identification, real contact/rights handling, data categories, retention/deletion and transfers for the applicable jurisdiction without inventing personal details.
Update public current-state wording, provider/control details, date and policy version before enabling ads.
Test CSP and actual browser/network/storage behavior before consent, after refusal/acceptance/withdrawal and on repeat visits.
